processing_steps.method: First-principles DFT geometry optimization and property calculation (CASTEP, GGA-PBE)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Computational study with no experimental thermal/mechanical processing. Ultrasonic pseudopotentials; GGA-PBE exchange-correlation; 8×8×8 Monkhorst–Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2×10^-6 eV; forces below 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹.

structures.overall_structure: Cubic supercell structure with space group Pm-3m; Mn atoms substitute for Fe atoms on the Fe sublattice of B2-type FeAl; 16-atom cell with one Mn atom replacing one Fe atom; optimized lattice parameter a = b = c = 0.572 nm.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: First-principles DFT calculation (CASTEP, GGA-PBE); 8×8×8 Monkhorst–Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff.

electrical_properties.electronic_conductivity: Metallic character (nonzero DOS at the Fermi level); good electronic conductivity

magnetic_properties.magnetic_character: Magnetic characteristics due to dissymmetric up and down spin states

properties.bonding_characteristics: Combination of mainly covalent and metallic bonds (hybridization of low Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d states); weaker covalent bond effect.

computational_details.potential_model_or_database: GGA-PBE exchange-correlation; ultrasoft pseudopotentials; valence states: Fe 3d^6 4s^2, Mn 3d^5 4s^2, Al 3s^2 3p^1
computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Monkhorst–Pack 8×8×8 k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2×10^-6 eV; forces reduced to 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Calculated lattice parameters show good agreement with other experimental and calculated values.

analytical_models.model_note: E_coh and ΔH_f computed from total energies of the compound and isolated/bulk atomic references.

analytical_models.equation_role: Bulk modulus, shear modulus, Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio from elastic constants (Eqs. 4–9)
analytical_models.model_note: B_VRH = B_V = B_R = (C11+2C12)/3; G_V, G_R and G_VRH = (G_V+G_R)/2; E and σ from B and G.

analytical_models.equation_role: A^U, A_B, A_G and A_1 = A_2 = A_3 (Eqs. 11–14)
analytical_models.model_note: Universal anisotropic index, bulk/shear anisotropy and shear anisotropic factors listed in Table 3.

analytical_models.model_name: Debye temperature and sound velocity model
analytical_models.model_note: Debye temperature from average sound velocity; velocities from B, G and density.

unmapped_findings: Fe0.875Mn0.125Al is thermodynamically stable (negative formation enthalpy −0.376 eV·atom⁻¹ and negative cohesive energy −6.920 eV·atom⁻¹).
Fe0.875Mn0.125Al satisfies the cubic mechanical stability criteria (C11−C12 > 0, C11 > 0, C44 > 0, C11+2C12 > 0), hence is mechanically stable.
Fe0.875Mn0.125Al is classified as brittle because its B/G ratio (1.75) is not greater than the 1.75 ductility threshold.
In the descending anisotropy order, Fe0.875Mn0.125Al ranks just above FeAl (A^U = 1.03), i.e., second lowest elastic anisotropy among the studied Fe–Mn–Al alloys.
